metadata.description: MakePartsNow.com's official plugin for Claude: instant 3D printing and CNC machining quotes and orders from your CAD files.

plugins.name: make-parts-now
plugins.description: Instant 3D printing and CNC machining quotes from your CAD files (STL, STEP, 3MF, OBJ): price and ship date for SLS nylon, FDM plastic, aluminum and brass parts made in the US. Change the quote and get a checkout link in the chat.
